name: Crawl Bach Hoa Xanh - Save to PostgreSQL

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO crawl_data (
  url, status_code, title, title_length,
  meta_description, meta_description_length, meta_keywords,
  og_title, og_description, og_image, og_url,
  canonical_url, favicon, viewport, charset, robots_meta,
  h1_tags, h1_count, h2_tags, h2_count, h3_tags, h3_count,
  total_links, internal_links, external_links,
  total_images, images_with_alt, images_without_alt,
  word_count, links_json, images_json, crawled_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.url }}',
  {{ $json.status_code }},
  '{{ $json.title?.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.title_length }},
  '{{ $json.meta_description?.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.meta_description_length }},
  '{{ $json.meta_keywords?.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.og_title?.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.og_description?.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.og_image }}',
  '{{ $json.og_url }}',
  '{{ $json.canonical_url }}',
  '{{ $json.favicon }}',
  '{{ $json.viewport }}',
  '{{ $json.charset }}',
  '{{ $json.robots_meta }}',
  '{{ $json.h1_tags?.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.h1_count }},
  '{{ $json.h2_tags?.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.h2_count }},
  '{{ $json.h3_tags?.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.h3_count }},
  {{ $json.total_links }},
  {{ $json.internal_links }},
  {{ $json.external_links }},
  {{ $json.total_images }},
  {{ $json.images_with_alt }},
  {{ $json.images_without_alt }},
  {{ $json.word_count }},
  '{{ $json.links_json?.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.images_json?.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.crawled_at }}'
)
RETURNING id, url, title, crawled_at;
